preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the permutation N must be between 2 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for x in P) and len(P) == N
preconditions.description: The permutation P must contain all integers from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.expression:
stdout == str(min_total_cost) + '
' + str(K) + '
' + '
'.join(f'{i} {j}' for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum total cost, the number of operations K, and the operations performed.

postconditions.expression: min_total_cost == sum(abs(i - j) for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: The minimum total cost must equal the sum of the costs of all operations performed.
After performing the operations, the permutation P must be sorted in increasing order.
